description: Propose rolling a policy back to one of its revisions (list_policy_revisions): its whole configuration - apps, settings, restrictions, networks - is restored, and its name goes back to the revision's when they differ (the change list shows it); description, tags and group stay. Nothing changes yet: this returns a proposal with the differences. Show it to the user and get their explicit approval. A rollback of a policy that has devices is HIGH impact. Once the user approves, apply it with apply_policy_proposal (a person approves a HIGH impact one in the Nomid portal instead: give the user its approvalUrl).

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

policyId.description: The policy's path name - the unique identifier returned by list_policies as "pathName".

revision.description: The revision to restore, from list_policy_revisions.

name: rollback_policy
title: Propose a policy rollback
